title: Inheritance and Portrait
author: Noor Blackwood
blurb: Cyrus Okonkwo, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
